name: Trista Wood
background: Trista Wood is the Laramie County treasurer-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Tammy Deisch, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 county-office candidate roster lists her as a Republican from Cheyenne. A second Republican filer, Renee Garner, withdrew before the primary. Wood was unopposed in the August 18, 2026, primary and the November 3, 2026, general election. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official roster, county election results, or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
